text:
maria: deploy-bot flagged release window, CI failing on staging bundle step. looks like an unexpected cache layer corruption on the artifact store. stacktraces in job logs.

devon: ugh. which job? can we rerun just the bundle step?

maria: job: build-bundle-246 (staging). screenshot from the agent: 
```
ERROR: failed to extract layer: checksum mismatch on shard 42
artifact-store: GET /mirror/objects/idx-042 -> 200 but payload crc32c != expected
```

sujal: that shard number feels new — we rolled the new index sharding yesterday. maybe the migration left a stale replica.

lina: if it's a replica-only corruption, reuploading shard 42 from the origin should fix. but that's manual and risky during change window. suggestion: pin to last-good artifact digest and promote?

maria: product team wants the rollout. options: 1) manual reupload + rerun 2) pin to previous digest and promote 3) rollback the index sharding change (heavy).

devon: I'd prefer pin-to-last-good. lower blast radius and quick. how do we pin from the deploy side?

sujal: we can override the artifact ref in deploy-orchestrator: set RELEASE_ARTIFACT=sha256:0f3a9... and re-trigger canary. small PR to infra needed, but we can hotpatch via deploybot if allowed.

maria: @deploy-bot any automation for hotpatch artifact pin?

deploy-bot: Can apply temporary artifact override via /deploy override-artifact <env> <service> <digest>. Requires release-manager approval.

lina: pinging @release-manager for approval. also we should post a short blurb in release notes about temporary pin and follow-up remediation.

maria: approval received verbally. doing the override now. command: `/deploy override-artifact staging web-frontend sha256:0f3a9b7c`

ci-orchestrator: Received override request. Starting canary with pinned artifact. Running bundle step -> queued.

devon: running smoke locally against pinned artifact looked clean. if canary passes, we can proceed and schedule a postmortem on shard replication.

sujal: logging follow-up action: revert sharding migration on a branch and run full validation against restored shards; aim to reintroduce after extra integrity checks.

maria: canary green ✅ (small latency bump within SLO). promoting to staging and will monitor for 30m then promote to prod in the change window.

lina: add release-notes line: "Temporarily pinned web-frontend artifact to avoid staging bundle extraction failure; follow-up: artifact-store shard integrity audit."

devon: after promotion, schedule a brief maintenance ticket for artifact-store to rehydrate shard 42 and verify checksums.

maria: thanks team. adding postmortem owner @sujal. closing thread after prod promote. :white_check_mark:
